summary: Firefox is moving more font handling to Skrifa, its shared font-parsing and shaping infrastructure, for metrics, glyph lookup, variation data, font tables, and downloaded webfonts across platforms. CSS now recognizes Fangsong and Kai font families, while font caches, character maps, and locking were improved for safer concurrent use and better performance. Graphics sanity checks also cover hardware video encoding, Linux disables hardware decoding when DMA-BUF is unavailable, and about:support now reports whether the CMS color-management output profile is active.
